description: Israel's Central Bureau of Statistics publishes a workbook of selected 2022 Census data for every locality and every statistical area within localities, about 3,380 rows with locality and statistical area codes. Its 49 columns give population, change since the 2008 Census and density, age and origin structure, disability, total households and their average size, the main lifestyle of households, computers per household, and the share of households without a motor vehicle, with two or more vehicles, with a parking space, and owning or renting their dwelling. Coverage is nationwide: 9,601,720 residents in 3,053,450 households, of which 26.4 percent had no motor vehicle and 62.9 percent had parking. Four more English workbooks on the same page give population and households by locality and characteristics compared with 2008, and a census data site offers the figures by district, locality, statistical area and other units with maps. Format and access: free XLSX, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: population and household counts are rounded approximations (their columns are named approx); the census data site and CBS subject pages need JavaScript. Simulation uses: statistical area car ownership and parking for travel demand and parking models, and households and density for exposure and service planning. Related records: the Israel green buildings register.
